title: CobblePie
description: CobblePie is a Cobblemon Survival server with Custom Pokemon, Megas, Raids, & More.
body:
Come join in CobblePie!

# Grab powerful Prism Pokemon to use on your team!

These pokemon all have unique types, moves, and abilities! Harness the terrifying power of Prism Mamoswine with it's unique ability to raise it's attack for the first three turns of combat... or Prism Comfey to defend your team with it's ability to make it only weak to Fire Types!

# Fight Powerful raids!

Every hour you can join in on raid pokemon, and defeating them will let you have a chance to grab them!

# Monthly Contests, Weekly Tournaments, and more!

There's always something to do, and always something to strive for! Build up a team for the next weekly tournament... or if you're not good with battling, You can enter build contests!

There's a lot to do, so join in on CobblePie and start your adventure today!
